definitions.explanation: A summer migrant bird named after its call. It lays its eggs in the nests of other birds, which raise its chicks.

examples.japanese: カッコウ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
⟦{高原|こうげん}→高原：05497_kougen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧カッコウ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I heard a cuckoo calling in the highlands.

examples.japanese: カッコウ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ほか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳥|とり}の{巣|す}→鳥の巣：24347_torinosu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{産|う}み→産む：01899_umu⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cuckoos lay their eggs in other birds' nests and do not raise their own young.

notes:
Usually written in katakana; the kanji spelling is {郭公|かっこう}. Its call is written カッコー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カッコウ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧: a cuckoo calls
- カッコウ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{托卵|たくらん}: the cuckoo's laying of eggs in other birds' nests
- {閑古鳥|かんこどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧: business is slack, a place is deserted ({閑古鳥|かんこどり} is an old name for the cuckoo)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse it with the homophone ⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧ (appearance, shape), as in ⟦かっこいい→かっこいい：09378_kakkoii⟧.
